methods.method: Separate diagnostic run; deliberate 500 ms page click-handler script, then reload; never mixed with timing samples
methods.decision: Use CDP totals after navigation and differences only inside one document. Readiness is driver-observed CSS/fonts/card completion plus two rAF opportunities; no final-paint claim.
methods.cacheProof: All workload trials include resource transfer observations; same-context warm reload is distinct from cold new context plus explicit cache clear.
methods.sourceScope: Versioned primary method definitions; pinned runtime API and observed controls establish compatibility here. These documentation revisions are not asserted to be the browser build source.

rejected_attempts.reason: Driver control appended behind full-screen HA host; pointer action could not reach it. New preflight positions the control explicitly; no forced activation.

Stopped by driver author before extended collection: fixed REST access token would expire during a 42-minute run. New run refreshes outside each timed workload; no subject change. Partial observations retained; no slow sample exclusion.

Stopped method pilot to require browser-observed final fixture state for every timed window, in addition to successful REST responses. Partial CPU observations retained, not excluded for speed. No subject change.

rejected_attempts.status: diagnostic probe failed; no timing captures discarded
rejected_attempts.reason: Inspector Runtime.evaluate busy-loop did not increment ScriptDuration by the assumed 400 ms minimum. Counter calibration requires an actual page event, or a specific unsupported result; no acceptance inference is made.
